# Cambodia Bible Education Centre (BEC)

> Official website of the Cambodia Bible Education Centre in Phnom Penh. Free Bible education and English classes for all Cambodians.

The canonical website is https://bec.cheddybytes.com.
The previous address https://bec.arian.my has permanently moved here.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/): Bible-English classes, group studies, and event gallery
- [Contact](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/contact): Address, map, Facebook, and Instagram
- [Forms](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/forms): Feedback form
- [Donate](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/donation): How to support BEC ministry
- [FAQ](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/faq): Visa, travel, and fieldworker questions

## Optional

- [Full site summary](https://bec.cheddybytes.com/llms-full.txt): Longer description for assistants
